Title: Order service database connection pool exhausted
Description: During checkout peaks the order service stops responding. Every request waiting on the connection pool times out after 30 seconds and the pool never recovers until the service is restarted.
Severity: Critical
Component: Database
Environment: Production
Error: OperationalError: QueuePool limit of size 10 overflow 0 reached, connection timed out
Stack_trace: File "orders/repository.py", line 88, in save_order
    with session_scope() as session:
  File "sqlalchemy/pool/base.py", line 1204, in _do_get
    raise exc.TimeoutError()
sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit reached
